observations: Only shear walls are calculated (8 Tedds sheets). No calcs for footings F1/F2/F3, LVL beams B101-B103/B201-B203, TJI-235 joists, 4x6/6x6 posts, garage walls GW1-GW3, retaining walls, stairs, holdowns or anchors.

Placeholder loads: every wall uses D = 25 lb/ft, Lf = 20 lb/ft, Lr = 10 lb/ft, W = 18 lbs, Eq = 40 lbs, SDS = 1 for a two-storey house (first-storey walls carry the same 40 lbs as second-storey walls); no base-shear calc. Resulting D/C ≤ 0.003 and all chord T negative, so holdowns HDU11/HDU14 are not justified by any calc.
2nd-floor holdown schedule (S-7.2) lists locations "1SW1-1SW4" again instead of 2SW1-2SW4, with HD1/HD2 assignments swapped vs the 1st-floor schedule.

Connector conflicts: connector schedule C1 = H2.4A and C3 = A35, but S-4.1 note says "(C3) H2.5A" at rafters and S-0 legend says C1 = H2.5A; C2 LUS210 described both "@ DRAG STRAP LOCATIONS" and at joist-to-beam.
Footing F1 size conflict: schedule/plan 24"X24"X12" vs foundation note 7 "24"X24"X10""; note numbering duplicates "8."; vapor barrier 10 MIL (S-1) vs 6 MIL (S-7); control joints 12'-0" vs 15'-0".

Anchor bolt conflict: S-1 5/8"Ø x 10" @ 6'-0" O.C. with 7" embed; S-9 detail 5/8"x8" @ 24" O.C. and 5/8" x 6" embed @ 32"/16" O.C.; holdown anchors 5/8" threaded rod "/ Slab" though plan shows stem walls/strip footings.

Sheathing: schedule says 7/16" OSB; calc uses 7/16'' OSB with long dimension across studs, 8d @ 4'' (vs1 760, vw1 1065 lb/ft) plus 5/8'' gypsum wallboard 0.120'' nails at 4'' (vs2 350, vw2 350 lb/ft), vwc = (vw1 + vw2) = 1415 lb/ft — wind capacity adds gypsum to OSB. Edge/field nailing not stated on drawings.
Strength distribution method used on multi-segment walls (DESIGN WARNING printed: no deflection/drift check) for 1SW1, 1SW2, 2SW1, 2SW4 etc.; several segments dropped for aspect ratio > 2.
Wall heights: 1st floor h = 9.167 ft, 2nd floor h = 8.5 ft; lengths 35 ft / 40 ft alternate (1SW1/1SW3/2SW1/2SW3 = 35 ft, 1SW2/1SW4/2SW2/2SW4 = 40 ft) suggesting a 35x40 footprint.
Editions: drawings 2025 CRC (and UBC general note) vs calcs NDS2018 + ASCE 7-16.
